answer: Reaching eligibility takes 56 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. The cipher register is checked at draw time, vault lists the eligible set, and raven seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 56 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A 162 account operation therefore ties up 8 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
